# flexyBayesOrchestra

`flexyBayesOrchestra` is the orchestra-composition layer for
[`flexyBayes`](https://github.com/max578/flexyBayes). The core `flexyBayes`
package is a self-contained Bayesian mixed-model engine (ASReml / lme4 / brms
grammar routed to greta, INLA, or brms, with cross-engine triangulation).
`flexyBayesOrchestra` adds the pieces that only make sense inside the wider
analytics constellation:

- **Surrogate emulators** — cheap stand-ins for expensive fits
  (`fit_surrogate()`, random-feature / Bayesian-linear emulators).
- **Ensemble sources** — ingest, verify, and represent external posterior
  ensembles (`fb_ensemble()`, `as_fb_ensemble()`, `verify_fb_ensemble()`).
- **Ensemble-derived priors** — turn an ensemble into a `flexyBayes` prior
  (`fb_prior_from_ensemble()`, `fb_pesto()`).
- **Surrogate posterior predictive checks** — MMD-based checks
  (`fb_surrogate_ppc()`, `fb_surrogate_ies()`).
- **Dormant cross-engine backend slots** — the koine fourth-opinion slot and
  the gretaR engine, registered against the `flexyBayes` backend registry.

If you only need Bayesian mixed models, install `flexyBayes` alone. Install this
package when you are composing `flexyBayes` with PESTO / kernR / the rest of the
orchestra.

## Installation

```{r eval=FALSE}
# installs flexyBayes (the core) and the orchestra optionals as needed
pak::pak("max578/flexyBayesOrchestra")
```

## Relationship to flexyBayes

```
flexyBayes            (core: mixed models + triangulation; CRAN / rOpenSci)
   ^
   | Imports
   |
flexyBayesOrchestra   (this package: surrogates, ensembles, derived priors;
                       r-universe / orchestra-internal)
```
